newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE Mar white sugar ends lower on $300 support.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE Mar white sugar ends lower on $300 support.

text.p: London's March white sugar ended on $300 support in solid turnover after traders said that major players pressured the spot value in mostly outright sales.
March accounted for the bulk of the day's activity but it several times just held at the psychological barrier as bargain hunters bought at the lows.
Traders said some five major players, including trade and commission houses, were dominating the session. "The big boys are ruling the roost," said one.
March last tradded at the day's low of $300 per tonne which was $2.30 weaker from Friday. Market sources said $295.00 was likely to be the next downside target if $300 was broken.
May was down $1.60 at $299.50 and overall volume totalled 2,711 lots.
